The ProteinGym paper describes the 2023 clinical sets; whether the sets behind the 144fe22 files are unchanged is not stated.

The use case excludes balanced pathogenic/benign classification as a measure of case-level diagnostic performance; this protocol is variant-level classification and does not measure recovery of causal variants in cases or review effort.
